company_blurb: Aurora Freight builds automated routing software and cold-chain logistics hardware for Nordic and Baltic shipping corridors. Founded in Helsinki, the firm balances steady freight operations with applied materials testing and fleet telemetry.

departments.culture: Pragmatic and reliability-focused, the Engineering team values clear architecture docs, reproducible builds, and calm post-release check-ins. Discussions center on latency budgets, telemetry uptime, and practical fixes rather than flashy rewrites.

Methodical and deadline-driven, Finance keeps Aurora Freight grounded with structured month-end closes, transparent cost tracking, and sober margin analysis. Colleagues appreciate tidy spreadsheets, early heads-up on spend changes, and punctual meetings.

Measured and approachable, Legal translates maritime rules, software terms, and compliance checklists into plain language. The team prizes thorough version history, well-organized repositories, and early collaboration before commercial commitments are signed.

Curious and empirical, Research blends hands-on environmental chamber testing with careful sensor data logging. Staff share bench time cooperatively, debate test tolerances openly, and take pride in cold-chain hardware that survives harsh weather.

Energetic and relationship-oriented, Sales focuses on steady shipping partnerships, accurate capacity quotes, and smooth handoffs to operations. Weekly pipeline syncs stay brisk, practical, and centered on long-term client retention.
